data.plainLyric:
Only love never hesitates
Only trust has a price to pay
Like a flower in a hurricane
We see the sun rise into another day

Only love never hesitates
Only trust has a price to pay
Like a flower in a hurricane
I will die before I walk away, walk away

All the crashes
Floods and flashes
And my heart is achin'
'Til I'm washed away once more

Let's take it fast, just like a flash
And in a moment, we'll be gone like a second chance
You and me, we don't let this life go rushin' past (oh)
I'll live it to the very last breath

Only love never hesitates
Only trust has a price to pay
Like a flower in a hurricane
We see the sun rise into another day

Only love never hesitates
Only trust has a price to pay
Like a flower in a hurricane
I will die before I walk away, walk away

(And you know) you know I think about it now and then (uh-huh)
Is it a matter of not if, but when? (Uh-huh)
Somethin' beautiful comin' to an end (an end)
And if we ever get there
